hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: The area bounded between two vertical posts is limited by the shorter post multiplied by width.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Place pointers at extreme left and right boundaries.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Advance the pointer pointing to the shorter vertical post inward.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def widestFenceArea(heights: list[int]) -> int:
    left = 0
    right = len(heights) - 1
    max_area = 0
    while left < right:
        h = min(heights[left], heights[right])
        max_area = max(max_area, h * (right - left))
        if heights[left] < heights[right]:
            left += 1
        else:
            right -= 1
    return max_area
```
